"""Behavior: note.archive

Archives a live note. Read only against the kernel; all state changes go
through the store.
"""

from kernel import AppError, require_session


def archive_note(store, session, note_id=None):
    require_session(session)

    if not note_id:
        raise AppError("INVALID_PARAMETER")

    note = store.note(note_id)
    if note is None:
        raise AppError("NOT_FOUND")

    if note.get("archived"):
        raise AppError("ALREADY_ARCHIVED")

    note["archived"] = True
    saved = store.save_note(note)

    return {
        "id": saved["id"],
        "title": saved["title"],
        "archived": saved["archived"],
    }
